lines.text: I have come to help. You will need it.
lines.spoken: I have come to help... You will need it.

lines.text: Go with God. He is expecting you.
lines.spoken: Go with God... He is expecting you.

lines.text: I will pray for you. You need it more than most.
Kindness is free. So was that beating.
Sit. Rest. I will fetch you some soup and a splint.
You give away prizes. I give second chances. This was not one.
Such language. Go wash your mouth out with my soup.
